description: This file defines the LeaveListController class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing the leave list view in the leave plugin module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and includes methods to set up properties for rendering leave data, such as leave types, statuses, employee details, and date filters. The controller interacts with various services and utilizes traits for functionality enhancement. It also manages access control for employee data based on user roles.

classes.name: LeaveListController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling leave list view, managing leave-related properties, access control, and interaction with backend services for the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureService used to fetch organizational subunits.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and properties for the leave list component, including employee info, leave types, statuses, date filters, and organizational subunits. Also enforces access control.

methods.name: addLeaveStatusesProp
methods.description: Adds an array of leave statuses with localized labels to the component properties.

methods.name: addLeaveTypeProp
methods.description: Adds leave type information to the component if a leaveTypeId is provided in the request.

methods.name: addLeaveStatusProp
methods.description: Adds specific leave status info to the component based on the request's status parameter.

methods.name: addFromToDateProps
methods.description: Adds from-date and to-date filters to the component if provided in the request.
